messages:
nina: postmortem follow-up: noise reduction items summarized, owners assigned. starting thread to avoid duplicate pings.
sam: can we prioritize by pages/day and business impact?
leo: pages/day last 7d: image-queue-delay (40/day), inference-timeout (25/day), slot-exhaust (10/day).
nina: ok priority order: image-queue-delay, inference-timeout, slot-exhaust. owners: sam (image-queue-delay), leo (inference-timeout), nina (slot-exhaust). due: 2026-04-11, 2026-04-06, 2026-04-09 respectively.
sam: image-queue-delay plan: implement dedupe by image_id + bucket and add suppression during scheduled migrations. I'll implement collapse_window=8m. owner: sam.
leo: inference-timeout: raise threshold for batch endpoints to 3s and keep 1s for interactive. add non-paging warn at 1s. owner: leo.
ina: slot-exhaust: suppression for maintenance windows + route to ops only if >95% for 15m. owner: nina.
sara: ops-bot create follow-ups. include runbook links.
ops-bot: Created: #INC-2801 (sam), #INC-2802 (leo), #INC-2803 (nina).
sam: PR for collapse rule in staging, testing with replay. link INC-2801.
leo: attaching perf histograms in INC-2802. asking infra for approval.
nina: updated runbook for slot-exhaust with maintenance tag logic.
sara: add a monthly check to review noise trends and confirm reduction targets. ops-bot set recurring.
ops-bot: Monthly noise audit scheduled starting 2026-05-01.
sam: quick note: set alert acceptance criteria in INC-2801: pages/day < 5 for image-queue-delay after 7d of rollout.
leo: will verify inference-timeout changes in canary. will report back.
sara: thanks. close this thread when tickets in progress. :thumbsup:
